pr.title: build(ci): adopt the released Platform 1.4 tuple
pr.body:
Current EventStore CI refuses package preparation because its Platform revision is untagged, its direct Builds selection differs from Platform, and its module tool is below the supported range. Select genuine [Platform 1.4.0](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/releases/tag/v1.4.0) at ae7516ee6961dd31a5e319be59ead76449ab04a0, matching published [Builds 4.44.3](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/releases/tag/v4.44.3) at fc2122240a39f03628c04fa8433e5eece90b8b4c, and exact module CLI 4.44.3. Update the matching caller-contract assertion.

Validation: committed Release/package Contracts build passed with zero warnings/errors; all 13 focused caller, reference-owner, dependency-mode and publication-contract cases passed with no skips. Unchanged normal shared preparation passed at the clean committed source, and actual prepared Contracts/native-project MSBuild evaluations select SDK 4.1.0/Tenants 7.0.2. Parent independently checked the complete four-path change, 99 unchanged test-output DLLs and all 310 actual tool payloads against the genuine signed archive. Full hosted CI/native qualification remains required.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Version pin and test expectation only; no runtime, auth, or release logic changes in this diff.
> 
> **Overview**
> Aligns EventStore CI package preparation with **Hexalith Builds 4.44.3** by bumping the local **`hexalith.builds.module.cli`** tool in `.config/dotnet-tools.json` from **4.44.0** to **4.44.3** (`rollForward` stays **false**).
> 
> The **Shared CI v2** packaging contract test now expects **4.44.3** when it reads `dotnet-tools.json`, so the pinned module CLI version cannot drift from what domain-ci v2 requires.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 1e8fd617b39db0c839a68031968f7639f9206518. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
